params.title: The morning after a bad night

caption.instagram:
You can't fix your sleep at night. You fix it in the morning.

Up at 7 all week, sleep in till 10 on the weekend: that's 3 hours. By Monday your body clock is in another time zone.

The sleep reset:
1. One wake-up time, 7 days a week (say 7:30)
2. Daylight within 10 minutes: curtains open, coffee by the window
3. Work backwards: need 8 hours? Bed at 11:30, wind-down alarm at 11

Weekends: 1 hour later, max. 8:30, not 10.

Send this to the friend who sleeps until noon on Sundays.

Dmyor: archive your dream today, break it into steps you can actually do. Link in bio.
